verdict.rationale: The vendor claims Bionic (an LM Studio companion app) offers real-time speech transcription ('Talk to Bionic naturally, and your speech gets transcribed in real time'), but this is a single unverified marketing claim with no community evidence confirming it works, and no clarity that transcription itself runs on-device versus using a cloud/frontier model backend as Bionic also touts frontier hosted models like GLM 5.2 and DeepSeek V4 Pro.
